title: Choline for Hair: Benefits, Best Food Sources & Why Most People Fall Short
seo_title: Choline for Hair Growth: Benefits & Best Sources | FullyVital
seo_description: Why choline matters for fast-growing hair follicle cells, what the hair research shows, and the easiest ways to get more choline from food.
notes: Citation style v2 (your rule): 3 studies, each cited once, all in the second half; Key Takeaways and FAQ carry no links. Kept all three studies (Wickett, Jung & Kwon, Zeisel & da Costa) but now cite each once, in the second half. Zeisel's pregnancy and liver-health aside is removed from the safety paragraph.

Positive angle backed by evidence: choline is essential and under-consumed; added the 9-month choline-stabilized silicon trial on hair strength and thickness, with its caveat (silicon is the main active).
Removed unsupported claims that choline directly promotes hair growth.
Food sources now sourced (eggs and meat up to 430 mg/100 g).
Added Key Takeaways, FAQ and references. No reviewer line.
flags: The closing FullyVital product box (unchanged, sitewide) says products 'Promote Hair Regrowth'. Left for you, as with boron.
